in_sanskrit.name: Minarul
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Moonlight
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Minarul एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Minarul is derived from the Sanskrit word 'minar' which means 'moon' and 'rul' meaning 'light'. This name signifies the gentle, calming light of the moon. In Hindu mythology, the moon is associated with the god Chandra or Shiva and represents peace, tranquility, and fertility.
